Mississauga couple, $700K home: could two FHSAs get you to the down payment?

Example only, simple arithmetic:
1) Two partners x $8,000 annual FHSA limit = $16,000 in year one.
2) Year two: another $16,000, so $32,000.
3) Year three: another $16,000, so $48,000.
The minimum down payment on a $700,000 home is $45,000 (5% of the first $500,000 + 10% of the remaining $200,000). Closing costs are extra.
Assumes both partners are eligible first-time buyers who each contribute the $8,000 annual limit, with no investment growth or tax refunds counted. FHSA lifetime limit is $40,000 per person. Sources: CRA FHSA pages (last updated Feb 2026); Department of Finance Canada. Check current rules.

Etobicoke renewal offer: it may cost you if you just sign.
